title: Final F*ck

body.intro:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
In the case of Windows 8.1 / 10, you must enable DirectPlay.
Control Panel > Programs and Features > Turn windows features on or off
> Legacy Components > DirectPlay Checkbox. Click OK to save and return.

If the game does not operate on Windows Vista, 7, 8, 10
then follow the troubleshooting steps located here:
http://support.microsoft.com/kb/932104/ja

Right Click Language Bar > Settings > Add Services
> Add "Microsoft IME" under Japanese Language.
Then change your default language setting to "Microsoft IME"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

NONKI's 2nd weapon action series title is here!

Violence and sex! Evil Mega Saturn has invaded
Astro City... amidst the chaos and danger this city's
defenders rise. They are the Lady Warriors!

Strike justice with grapples to crushing blows and chained pummeling punches!

Check out the playable trial!

* 4 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
Azukina the Kunoichi Blader
Miruku the Fundoshi Sailor
Power Wrestler Berry
Genki Chinese Fighter Cherry

* 2 ACTION MODES
Choose between...
Erotic "Fuck Mode" (standard difficulty)
Non-erotic "Final Mode" (hard difficulty)

* CHARACTER GALLERY MODE
There's an in-game pixel art appreciation mode
for quick access if you're not into action and to keep
the immersion-breaking ecchi separate from action
for gaming purists! Enjoy a variety of color options, too!

* GALLERY VIEWER
Get an eyeful of illustations and sketches
with the built in viewer.

* STAFF
Created by NONKI
http://nonkigame.x.fc2.com/

Gallery viewer programmed by
Toushiryoku Laboratory

Azukina (CV: Maria Ayana)
Miruku (CV: Kurumi Miru)
Berry (CV: Ryo Suzuki)
Cherry (CV: Mikan Nonaka)
